Published

Nov 11, 2026 at 10:43 AM EST

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

President Donald Trump’s net approval among registered U.S. voters aged 18 to 29 saw a double-digit drop after Democrats’ sweeping midterm victory, according to new polling from The Economist/YouGov series. results.title: Trump's Approval Rating Plunges With Gen Z After Midterms - Newsweek

results.content: There are, I guess, still millions of Americans who thrill to the music of MAGA, but the music has lost its magic for a big chunk of GOP voters. The percentage of Americans who strongly approve of Trump’s performance, the Economist/YouGov polls found, dropped from 34 percent in January 2025 to 18 percent in April 2026. A Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted in August found Trump’s strong approval even lower at 13 percent. Picture MAGA voters slinking off to their man caves, shaking their heads.
